d:
Kabhi Tu Chhalia Lagta Hai is a beautiful duet from the 1991 classic Patthar Ke Phool, bringing together two of Bollywood's greatest voices! The melodious voices of Lata Mangeshkar & S. P. Balasubrahmanyam, paired with Raam Laxman's soulful composition, make this one of the most romantic songs of the early 90s.

Song : Kabhi Tu Chhalia Lagta Hai
Movie : Patthar Ke Phool (1991)
Star Cast : Salman Khan & Raveena Tandon
Singers : Lata Mangeshkar & S. P. Balasubrahmanyam
